title: Bound the Linux Plan04 tenant scan
goal: Remove the Linux tenant timeout without changing its source-tree lock, semantics, or 60-second ceiling.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter enumerates only .cs semantic inputs and rejects linked directories and files.

The existing 60-second capability ceiling remains unchanged.
The owning suite, matrix contract, focused Linux run, and final certification pass.
